pitch_note: You're one of the only fixed-fee SOC 2 firms actively publishing on Drata AND Secureframe workflows for cloud-native startups — that's precisely who LoxeAI is built for. If it holds up to your standards, your pre-audit clients get a 'run this scan first — it gets you 80% ready' step that shortens your readiness phase, and NDB gets first look at every startup the scan surfaces.
